findings.title: float: right on .small-action button no longer works inside new flex container
findings.body: The PR turns .small-action into a flex container (@include flexbox()), but the button inside it still relies on `float: right` (line ~309) to be pushed to the right edge. CSS floats are ignored on flex items, so the button will now render immediately after the .small-action-desc content instead of being right-aligned. The same applies to the leftover `float: left` declarations on .topic-avatar and .small-action-desc .avatar. The layout should be expressed with flex properties (e.g. margin-left: auto on the button) or the floats removed, otherwise the small-action row layout regresses.

findings.title: align-items mixin emits non-existent -ms-align-items property
findings.body: The new align-items mixin includes `-ms-align-items: $alignment;` (line 121). There is no such property: IE10/11 only support the 2012 syntax `-ms-flex-align`, which is already emitted on the previous line. The bogus declaration is silently ignored by browsers, so it is dead output in every compiled stylesheet that uses the mixin; it should be removed.

findings.title: .valign-helper rule is now dead code after flexbox switch
findings.body: .d-header .contents is now a flex container with align-items: center, which makes the .valign-helper element (display: inline-block; height: 100%; vertical-align: middle) — a hack for vertical centering in inline-block layouts — completely ineffective, since vertical-align has no effect on flex items and height: 100% inside a flex row behaves differently. The rule (and the corresponding markup, if any) should be removed to avoid confusion.
